### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**What it lists.** Every environment variable that snapy's library, its Python package or its package build reads
or sets at the pin: 20 variables in four groups. **Defaults.** Four numerics switches off, the corrected-PE gravity
work on; launch variables fall back to a single CPU process. **Rule.** The five numerics switches are read once
per process and cached; nothing checks that ranks agree. **Full treatment.** @sec-ch12.
:::

This appendix is the index that the physics chapters cite for a run-time switch: one row per variable, with the line
that reads it at the pin, its default, its effect and the chapters that use it. @sec-ch12 owns the treatment: the
parsing rules in @sec-ch12-environment, the launch variables in @sec-ch12-layout and the switch combinations in
@sec-ch12-matrix. Variables that only snapy's tests read are in @sec-ch12-test-environment and are not repeated here.

### Derivation

None: the switches select schemes whose derivations are in the chapters listed in each row.

### Numerical method

The five numerics switches go through `get_env` ({{< code src/layout/layout.hpp get_env >}}), which returns the default only when the
variable is absent. Each accessor lower-cases the value, compares it with `0`, `false`, `off` and `no`, and keeps
the result in a function-local static, so the first call fixes the choice for every block of the process. Three
switches default to off (`SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT`, `SNAP_WB_REF4`, `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE`), and for them an empty
value is also off. Two default to on: `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE`, which an empty value turns off, and
`SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT`, which an empty value leaves on; the latter acts only where `radial_exact_work`
({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::radial_exact_work >}}) finds face gravity work on a grid with an $x_1$ measure,
Cartesian, spherical-polar or gnomonic-equiangle. `SNAP_WB_REF4` is also on whenever `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT` is, through
`x1_centroid_exact_enabled` ({{< code src/hydro/wb_ref4.cpp wb_ref4_enabled >}}).

The launch variables are read each time layout options are constructed, and again for `BACKEND` and `DEVICE` when
they are read from YAML. The `BACKEND` default comes from `default_backend` ({{< code src/layout/layout.cpp default_backend >}}). The three
communication defaults are written, not read, by `set_default_env` ({{< code src/layout/process_group_ucx.cpp set_default_env >}}), only when the variable is
unset and only in a build with UCX; they are listed because they change the process environment that commux sees.

### Tests

The seam tests set the numerics switches per ctest entry:

- `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT=1` ([`CMakeLists.txt:48`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/CMakeLists.txt#L48));
- `SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT` set to 1 and to 0 ([`CMakeLists.txt:50-52`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/CMakeLists.txt#L50-L52));
- `SNAP_WB_REF4=1` ([`CMakeLists.txt:55`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/CMakeLists.txt#L55));
- `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE=1` ([`CMakeLists.txt:60`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/CMakeLists.txt#L60));
- two-rank centroid, radial-exact and reference arms, `seam_arm_mp` ([`CMakeLists.txt:87-90`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/CMakeLists.txt#L87-L90));
- the balance-column arms, under `SNAP_WB_REF4` and under `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT` ([`CMakeLists.txt:98-103`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/CMakeLists.txt#L98-L103)).

The exchange tests set `BACKEND=gloo`
([`CMakeLists.txt:151`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/CMakeLists.txt#L151)) and `BACKEND=ucx` ([`CMakeLists.txt:165`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/CMakeLists.txt#L165)). `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE` has no ctest arm in `tests/CMakeLists.txt`;
its arms are set inside the Python tests `test_flux_covariance_rows.py`, `test_flux_covariance_seams.py`,
`test_horizontal_flux_covariance.py` and `test_wb_ref4_order.py` (@sec-ch12-flux-covariance). The registered names
are in @sec-appc.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
A numerics switch that differs between ranks makes shared faces two-valued, and no code compares the ranks' values.
A numerics switch changed after the first call has no effect in that process.
:::

- `distribute/backend` in YAML passes the key check but is never read; only `BACKEND` selects the backend.
- `LOCAL_RANK` has two defaults: 0 in the C++ layout options, the rank modulo the GPU count in `init_dist`.
- An unset `NC_HOME` adds the literal path `None/lib` to the package build's library path.
- The table covers `src/`, `python/` and `setup.py` at the pin; environment variables read by kintera, pyharp,
  commux, PyTorch or UCX themselves are not listed.
